description.en: PlayMogo is a video hosting and streaming service.

settings.title: Privacy Mode
settings.description: Hide video titles, timestamps, and page links.

settings.title: Show Browsing Status
settings.description: Show an activity when browsing without an active video.

settings.title: Video Title
settings.description: Choose whether common source-site suffixes are removed.

settings.title: Show Playback State
settings.description: Show Playing, Paused, or Video ended.

settings.title: Show Playback Icon
settings.description: Show a play or pause icon as the small activity image.

settings.title: Hide When Paused
settings.description: Clear the activity while the video is paused.

settings.title: Show Timestamps
settings.description: Show media playback timing while the video is playing.

settings.title: Timestamp Mode
settings.description: Choose which playback timestamp Discord receives.

settings.title: Show Video Button
settings.description: Show a button to the video's normal PlayMogo page.
